overview: The Medford School Committee met to review administrative reports, approve a high school service learning trip to the Dominican Republic, set the 2017 graduation date, and discuss recommendations for state legislative modifications regarding marijuana legalization.

items.title: Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the November 7, 2016 meeting along with routine bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: MASC Delegate Assembly Report
items.summary: Received and placed on file a report by member Robert Skerry on the MASC Delegate Assembly and its voted resolutions.

items.title: Dominican Republic Service Learning Trip
items.summary: Approved an EF Educational Tours service learning trip to the Dominican Republic for high school students in grades 10 through 12.

items.title: Project 351 Student Ambassador Report
items.summary: Received a report introducing Andrews Middle School student Marvin Michelle as a Project 351 student ambassador.

items.title: Veterans Day Program Report
items.summary: Received a report detailing the annual Veterans Day speaking program, which brought 16 veterans into high school classrooms.

items.title: Technology Reasonable Use Policy
items.summary: Tabled the proposed technology reasonable use policy to review updated guidance from external organizations.

items.title: Joint MASC/MASS Conference Report
items.summary: Received a report on the joint MASC/MASS conference covering topics including MCAS 2.0 implementation, social-emotional learning, and the SchoolBrains portal rollout.

items.title: Marijuana Legalization Legislative Recommendations
items.summary: Authorized drafting a letter to state legislators proposing local opt-in provisions, tax increases, and enhanced regulations following the legalization of recreational marijuana.

items.title: School Disciplinary Statistics Report
items.summary: Received the 2015–2016 disciplinary statistics report and requested a future breakdown of data by school level.

items.title: Guidance on National Election Results
items.summary: Received a report on administrative guidance sent to district staff emphasizing respectful classroom dialogue and prohibiting hate speech following the presidential election.

items.title: 2017 High School Graduation Date
items.summary: Approved June 7, 2017, as the graduation date for Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School.

items.title: Fellsway Crossing Guard and Signal Update
items.summary: Discussed ongoing coordination with state officials and DCR regarding pedestrian signal timing and crossing guard placement along the Fellsway.

items.title: Legal Opinion on American International College Contract
items.summary: Received a legal opinion from legal counsel concluding there is no conflict of interest for district employees working for American International College during building lease hours.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions and Executive Session
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for Manfredo Scaramuzzo and Denise Riley Bates before voting to enter executive session for negotiations and legal matters.
